title: consent-log.jsonl entry
description: One-entry-per-line audit record of every consent-gate firing. Append-only. See rules/dangerous-operations-policy.md §Audit trail. Validates a single parsed line; the file itself is JSONL (not a JSON array).

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Insertion-ordered but not guaranteed strictly monotonic (multi-session writes).

operation.description: Which Category from the Dangerous Operations Policy triggered the gate (e.g., 'package-install', 'file-system-write', 'ado-write', 'feedback-submission', 'git-operation', 'mcp-server-startup', 'channel-archive', 'last-member-leave', 'cross-channel-invite', 'verdict-override', 'budget-override').

decision.description: yes = user confirmed · no = user declined · timeout = 60s passed without response (default NO per §Enforcement).

input.description: Raw user input that was parsed into `decision`. Kept for forensic review — supports 'consent-bypass attempt' investigations (e.g., rationale containing 'I already consented').

run_id.description: Correlates this consent event with the triggering skill invocation.

channel.description: Channel in which the consent fired. Present iff consent is channel-scoped (most cases). Absent for session-level operations.
